_why_warmup: 2,100 is a FLOOR, not a taste: the previous-week level cannot exist before a full week of bars has closed (2,016 at 5m), and comparing it inside that week reports a warm-up as a defect. Inside the warm-up the gate feeds the export's own day/week levels, because a real run has history before its window and this export is a slice — the derived values are still computed and compared on every bar after it.
_what_it_ran: TWO exports of the same chart, and the FIRST is the one to run. It confirms on 5 minutes, which is the whole point: every stream the strategy reads is then rebuilt from the replayed bars and compared, and NOTHING is fed. The second confirms on 1 minute — the chart's shipped setting — and is kept because it gates that config, with the 1-minute stream fed. Both are the shipped defaults otherwise: confirmation OFF, first target 3.5R, 80% banked there, 4% risk, $4 minimum stop, both sessions, both directions, execution hours on.
_exercise_check: 10 trades on the 5m-confirmation export, reproduced bar for bar by the LAB path as well as by the gate: -1.0 x9 and +4.03, total -4.97R. ⚠ Refusal codes 1, 5, 7 and 9 never fired, and FOUR features never ran — breakeven on an opposite shift, the time stop, the at-the-zone entry mode and the no-gap entry mode. The gate names every one on every run.
_fed_not_compared: NOTHING, on the 5-minute-confirmation export. On the 1-minute one, only the confirmation stream — a 1-minute bar cannot be rebuilt from a 5-minute chart by any means.
